'''Vurly''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] medical technician during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[MedStar Four]]'' orbiting [[Despayre]].
